why: Stenographer capture is tag-driven. Clerk draft quality depends on explicit tagged spans; without spans, clerk can only infer from sparse task/checkpoint text.

markers.rule: Every start marker needs one matching stop marker. Keep one span focused on one evidence type.

snippets.body:
Summary: <implementation slice completed>
What changed: <short factual summary>

Decision: <chosen path>
Rationale: <why>
Alternatives rejected: <if any>

Command: <command actually run>
Result: <pass/fail/output summary>
Residual risk: <if any>

Next step: <concrete continuation>
Do not forget: <important constraint>

clerk_rules.rule: Clerk output is a review-only draft until an agent/operator validates and approves it.
clerk_rules.quality_gate: Ask clerk for a closeout draft only after minimum_closeout_span_kinds are present or explicit checkpoint fields are supplied.

validation_checklist: changed_files are grounded in real touched files
decisions and rejected alternatives are not invented
formal verification is distinct from live diagnostic/operator feedback
next_safe_action: Capture minimum closeout spans before finish_task; ask clerk for a review-only draft only after grounded spans exist.

coverage_messages.unscoped_next_safe_action: Provide task_id to assess stenographer span coverage for recovery.
coverage_messages.unknown_next_safe_action: Stenographer span coverage could not be read; continue with explicit checkpoint fields.
coverage_messages.complete_next_safe_action: Use clerk_draft_report or draft_checkpoint_from_spans, then validate the review-only draft before checkpointing.
coverage_messages.incomplete_warning: Stenographer spans exist, but closeout coverage is incomplete; clerk draft quality may be low.
coverage_messages.incomplete_next_safe_action: Add the missing closeout span kinds before asking clerk for a closeout draft.
coverage_messages.none_warning: Stenographer is available but no tagged stenographer spans were found for this task; clerk draft quality will be low.
coverage_messages.none_next_safe_action: Before checkpoint/finish, add short tagged spans for checkpoint_hint, changed_files, verification, and next_step.
